title: Users & roles
subtitle: Portal accounts, their roles and what each role may do.
demoNotice: Simulated directory: changes are validated and audited but kept in this browser tab only (reset on reload). Accounts sign in through DataHub Portals — no password is ever stored here.

origin.demo: Demo account — also in DataHub Portals
origin.portal: Created here — needs a DataHub Portals account to sign in

directory.search: Search name, e-mail or employee number

details.noEmployee: This account is not linked to an employee record: it has no "own" or "team" data in the modules.
details.permissionsHint: The permissions of the role {{role}}, as they are now.
details.lastLoginHint: Recorded only for sign-ins through DataHub Portals in this session; never estimated.

protected.self: You cannot change your own role or status — ask another System Administrator.
protected.last-admin: This is the last active System Administrator: its role and status cannot change until another administrator is active.

form.employeeHint: Optional. Search by name or employee number; one account per employee.
form.signInNote: The account signs in through DataHub Portals with this e-mail address. No invitation e-mail is sent and no password is set here.

dialogs.roleBody: The new role decides everything this account may see and do. It applies from the account's next sign-in.
dialogs.deactivateBody: The account can no longer sign in. Its history and linked employee record are kept.
dialogs.suspendBody: The account is blocked from signing in until it is activated again.
dialogs.activateBody: The account can sign in through DataHub Portals again.
dialogs.linkBody: Modules use this link for the account's own records and, for managers, their team.
dialogs.unlinkBody: The account keeps its role, but has no own or team records in the modules until it is linked again.
dialogs.reasonRequired: Enter a reason (recorded in the audit log).

validation.duplicateEmail: Another account already uses this e-mail address.
validation.employeeInactive: Only active employees can be linked.
validation.employeeLinked: This employee is already linked to another account.
validation.self: You cannot change your own role or status.
validation.last-admin: The last active System Administrator cannot lose that role or be deactivated.

roles.intro: The seven system roles. Their identifiers are fixed across the portal and the backend; custom roles are not supported yet.

descriptions.system-admin: Everything, including system settings and users & roles.
descriptions.hr-admin: All HR modules, payroll approval and HR settings — not user and role management.
descriptions.hr-manager: HR modules and leave approval; payroll read-only; no settings.
descriptions.department-manager: Their own team only: employees, attendance, leave approval, recruitment (read-only), performance reviews, documents and team reports.
descriptions.employee: Self-service only: own profile, attendance, leave, performance, payslips and documents.

matrix.intro: Permissions are grouped by module; a role holds a permission when its column is ticked.
matrix.readOnly: Read-only: roles and their permissions are managed in the DataHub backend. Each user’s permissions come from their sign-in token.
matrix.lockedSystem: Only the System Administrator may hold this
matrix.lockedRole: The System Administrator always holds every permission
matrix.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see every role.
